blocks.text: This chapter covered entrepreneurship: innovation, problem-solving and value creation; design thinking as a human-centred method; creating a business plan with market analysis and financial planning; gathering market insights and pitching ideas; marketing and sales strategies; financial management; communication, storytelling and collaboration; and innovation and creativity, giving students tools to start and sustain their own ventures.

items: Understand users, plan the business, know the market, pitch well, manage money, communicate, collaborate, iterate and innovate.
